preselected_method: ml; selected using validation, not reselected using final results

feature_definitions.product_views: Cleaned past-month view rows for the customer/product; zero when unseen
feature_definitions.product_carts: Cleaned past-month cart-addition rows for the customer/product; zero when unseen
feature_definitions.product_purchases: Cleaned past-month product-purchase rows for the customer/product; zero when unseen
feature_definitions.hours_since_product_event: Hours from latest of all four historical event types to scoring; NaN when unseen
feature_definitions.product_buyers: Distinct historical purchasers per product across all historical products; missing count zero
feature_definitions.customer_events: All four historical event types across every product for the customer
feature_definitions.from_personal_history: One for an historically interacted candidate, zero for unseen popularity backfill

timezone: UTC; every interval inclusive start and exclusive end
eligibility: At least one valid positive-user/product-key historical event in December; no future activity or purchase requirement
candidate_rule: Latest-event personal history descending, product ID ascending; append unseen distinct-buyer popularity products, ID ties; stop at 100 unique products; previously purchased products allowed

ranking_rules.global_popularity: All historical products' distinct-buyer counts descending, then product ID ascending; absent counts are zero
ranking_rules.personal_recency: Personal-history products first; latest event among all four event types descending; past distinct-buyer count descending; product ID ascending; unseen products use popularity then ID

ml_score: decision_function margin; not a validated calibrated purchase probability
ml_ties: Descending margin, then frozen personalized-recency position, then product ID; no score rounding
metric_definitions: Reuse ranking_metrics from Phase 10B2A; macro among all eligible purchasers, micro across all distinct purchased pairs; binary NDCG ideal includes products outside candidates; no-purchase users remain in scoring/coverage

uncertainty.method: Paired purchaser-level percentile bootstrap of ML minus recency metric differences; same sampled user indices for all six endpoints
uncertainty.limitations: Pointwise intervals conditional on fitted model, this cohort, fixed retrieval and sampling; no training-refit, temporal or shared-product uncertainty; secondary endpoints exploratory, no simultaneous correction

conclusion_policy: Report both fixed primary endpoints. Both positive lower bounds support a final advantage under assumptions; a zero-crossing interval is inconclusive for that endpoint. No test-driven model/rule changes or alternative fits; validation-selected model remains ML.
candidate_freeze: Complete per-user candidate membership hashed and read-only December database fingerprinted before January labels; identical membership required for every method
access_control: Exclusive first-access ledger after protocol/readiness verification; subsequent verify uses saved purchaser metrics and frozen-model inference checks, not January labels
limitations: Conditional purchaser bootstrap with fixed model; no simultaneous correction for secondary endpoints, training-refit/temporal/shared-product dependence or online causal claims
scope: One final evaluation; no fit/tuning, no new candidates/features, no dashboard or deployment
